thread:
dina: Quick sync — telemetry epic prioritization for next cycle. Focus areas: dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, error analytics. Need to lock MVP scope by EOW.
ash: +1. Customers keep asking for per-route cost and token-level breakdowns. Dashboard first seems highest business value.
pj: Tracing hooks are high lift — SDK changes, sampling, backend storage. I'd call that v2 unless we do a really small spike.
michelle: For SRE needs, we want correlation IDs in spans and alerts for error-rate spikes. Sampling can be low (0.1) initially.
ryan: My read: prioritize cost breakdown + error analytics for the launch, tracing as stretch. That buys CS and finance value quickly.
dina: Proposed MVP scope (draft):
- Tenant cost dashboard (per-route + per-model token cost)
- Error analytics page (top errors, percentiles, spike alerts)
- Basic trace support for top 10 endpoints, sampling=0.1
- Rollout gating: feature flag + opt-in tenant list
ash: Implementation notes: need new ingestion topic and a small transform to emit per-request token/cost metadata. Retention: metrics 30d, traces 7d by default to control cost.
pj: Spike plan: 3d to prototype SDK hooks + trace headers. If prototype looks good, 2 sprints for full SDK + backend storage.
michelle: Ops constraints: initial QPS estimate unknown. Can we cap linting of telemetry to 500qps/tenant? We should add backpressure and backfill plan.
dina: Launch criteria (must-haves):
1) Dashboards surfaced in Console for opt-in tenants
2) Spike detection alerting configured + runbook
3) Ingestion pipeline healthy in staging and prod; <10% ingestion error rate
4) Cost estimate <= $X/month for pilot (finance sign-off)
ryan: OK — customers to involve in pilot: Acme, Nova, Crew. I'll reach out for acceptance criteria and sample workloads.
ash: Dependencies: eng-sdk owner (pj), infra (michelle), analytics ETL (ash). ETA: MVP in 6 weeks with current staffing if spikes small.
dina: Action items:
- dina: PRD + sample dashboards by Fri
- pj: start SDK spike (3d)
- ash: design ingestion topic + retention defaults
- michelle: draft runbook + SLOs
- ryan: customer pilot invites
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: telemetry-pipeline-spike -> staging @ 2024-11-20T02:00Z
pj: small code snippet for sampling config we'll trial:
```
tracing:
  sampling: 0.1
  headers: ["x-request-id","x-rw-trace"]
```
michelle: +1 on that config. Also want alert: error-rate > 3% over 5m for top routes.
dina: Good discussion — we'll finalize MVP list in the PRD and sync again Tuesday. If anyone has hard objections to tracing being v2, speak now. :thumbsup:
